blocks.body: About 100 minutes. Next you will learn This is the week’s apple, then do the lab in the app. The check at the end uses words from today only.
You just named today's job. Now the idea: This is the week’s apple. Then you will do the lab.

blocks.heading: This is the week’s apple
blocks.body:
You are not making a booklet yet. You are proving you can finish **one page**.

- A **title**
- A **short line under the title** (not a copy of the title)
- Two short **paragraphs**
- No red error
- Saved in a folder you can find

No table of contents this week. No website tools. No how-to steps. If you need steps, write “week 2” in your notes and leave them off this page.

items.title: Do not publish
items.body: Publishing (making a website or a PDF from your files) is weeks away. Valid and saved beats pretty.

blocks.lead: Flip each card. The front is a word from this lesson. The back is what it means here.

cards.back: A **short line under the title** (not a copy of the title)

blocks.heading: Do the work
blocks.body:
You just met the idea. Now do the lab: One page, done.

This lab can fail. Fail when: The title is empty, the short line copies the title, there is a numbered how-to, or a red error remains.

Expected: A clean page with a title, a distinct short line, and two paragraphs. Path written down.

blocks.lead: Walk the cards below, in order, to One page, done.
blocks.intro: How to One page, done. Walk the cards in order. Tick them in the lab after you actually do them.

steps.title: One page, done
steps.body: This is the whole move. The next cards are the steps, in order.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: Title: What a cut flower is.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: Under the title, write one short line that would make sense in a search hit. Do not copy the title word for word.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.body: In the body, two paragraphs: what a cut flower is, and what this handbook will not cover (growing from seed).

steps.title: Step 5
steps.body: Do not add numbered how-to steps. That is next week.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.body: Save. Confirm there is no red error. Write the file path in oxygen-bootcamp-work/day-06-page.txt.

blocks.body: The lab is done. Prove it with the check. Use words from today only.

blocks.q: The short line under the title is for…
options: Search hits and previews :  a reader sees it before the full page
A second title because one is never enough
blocks.why: If it copies the title, the reader sees the same sentence twice. Make it add a bit.
